seams.why: Adds hubAuthPlugin to Better Auth's plugins: the registration gate.
The auth package calls the Hub's access rules.
The web app calls the Hub's services from its API routes.
Renders the Hub's sign-in page instead of Kan's view.
Renders the invite-only notice instead of Kan's sign-up form.
Shows the Hub's product name, swaps Kan's project menu for HubSidebarTop, hides links the person has no permission for, and adds the back-office link.
The API package hosts the Hub's tRPC router and guards.
Mounts the Hub's back-office router at api.hub.
Only back-office admins may create projects (workspaces).
Only project admins may create templates.
Someone with no project yet goes to the home page, which explains the wait, instead of being asked to create a project.
switchWorkspace takes an optional redirect, so the home page can switch projects without being sent to /boards.
Makes the hidden attribute win over display utilities, which is how the Hub hides actions people have no permission for.
Create and import buttons only for people allowed to create; on the templates page only for project admins.
Shows the project's 总版 tile first; the empty list's create button follows the same permission rule as the page's.
Hides an action the person has no permission for instead of showing it disabled.
Hides an action the person has no permission for instead of showing it disabled.
Regenerated by pnpm whenever a dependency changes.
